body:
#2744 CI is RED at 31630ba433 (run 39275684356): 24 tests fail, all regen::score::* (completeness, oracle, score). You caused it; main is green.

Cause: run_path_isolated_test (test_env.rs, ~line 66) now does `.current_dir(home.path())`. The regen tests run as isolated children, so their cwd becomes a temp HOME that is not a git repository, and they panic with:
  completeness.rs:418 unwrap: "git worktree list --porcelain -z failed (exit status: 128): fatal: not a git repository"
Fix: remove `.current_dir(home.path())` from run_path_isolated_test so the child inherits the parent's cwd, exactly as on main. Then re-run the regen filter locally:
  cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib regen::score
It must pass, together with your test_env and task_1507 filters.

Scope: REVERT your changes to aida-cli-lib/src/agent_launch.rs and aida-cli-lib/src/session_end.rs (the #[cfg(test)] skip_process_chdir branches). The round-2 brief didn't ask for them, and test-only branching inside production launch code is not acceptable in a hygiene PR. If you think production cwd mutation needs fixing, file it as a separate bug. The scanner limitation note you added already documents it.

Gate: cargo fmt --all; make check-ci-fast; the targeted filters above; make check-ci-compile. Push, reply with the SHA, and don't merge or ship. This is a CI fix, not a new review round; the re-review is scoped to these two changes.
subject: #2744 CI red: revert current_dir(home) in run_path_isolated_test + drop agent_launch/session_end changes
